name: Gog
summary: Gog of the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, was the one the LORD spoke against through Ezekiel. In later years he would come against Israel like a storm, and the LORD would defeat him and his army.

key_moments.title: Gathers the Nations Against Israel
key_moments.description: The LORD told Ezekiel to prophesy against Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Gog would gather a great army with many nations and come against the land of Israel like a storm and a cloud.

key_moments.title: Meets the LORD's Fury
key_moments.description: When Gog came against Israel, the LORD's fury would rise. The land would shake greatly, and He would send pestilence, hail, fire and brimstone, so that many nations would know He is the LORD.

key_moments.title: Buried in the Valley of Hamon-gog
key_moments.description: The LORD would give Gog a burial place in Israel, and there Gog and all his army would be buried. Israel would spend seven months burying them to cleanse the land.
